query: For a 65-year-old man: among male ICU patients aged 60–70 with intracranial hemorrhage (first ICU stay), what is the 75th percentile of procedure burden in the first 72h? Report mean ICU LOS (days) and hospital mortality versus general ICU population.
final_sql: SELECT hrp75.procedures_75th_percentile, alos.avg_los, m.mortality_rate FROM high_risk_procedures_75th_percentile hrp75 JOIN avg_los alos ON 1=1 JOIN mortality m ON 1=1;
